title: Caregiver Burnout and Identity Loss: What It Really Does to Who You Are (And How to Find Your Way Back)
intro: There is a particular kind of loss that no one prepares caregivers for, and it rarely shows up on any list of burnout symptoms. It is not the exhaustion, though that comes.
